name: Web Research
description: Search the web and read pages as clean text. No API key is required: search uses DuckDuckGo's public HTML endpoint. Retrieved content is treated as untrusted input.
author: Auren-AI

tools.description: Search the web and return titles, URLs, and snippets. Use this first when you need current information you do not already have; then call web_fetch on the most promising result to read it.

query.description: What to search for, as you would type it into a search engine

limit.description: How many results to return (1-20, default 8)

tools.description: Open a public web page and return its readable text (scripts and markup removed) plus the page title. Use the URLs returned by web_search. Internal, loopback, and private addresses are refused, including via redirects.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a public page

tools.description: Render a public page in a headless browser and return its text. Use this when web_fetch returns little or no content because the page builds itself with JavaScript (single-page apps, dashboards, infinite scroll). Slower than web_fetch, so try web_fetch first. Requires a browser to be installed on the server.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a public page
